demonstration_policy: Same-task examples from the hash-verified training subset only; reject target IDs and duplicate examples; remove whole examples from the end if over budget
target_length_policy: Preserve the complete target question and RAG context; fail before generation if the target alone exceeds the input budget
incomplete_generation: No terminating EOS means incomplete, including a length-limited output; preserve raw output and extract an empty answer
completion: Export predictions.csv only after every input has a trace; an exception preserves partial logs and records failed status
test_access: Only explicit test mode plus final_test_frozen=true permits named test inputs
